name: OTI Architects Ltd

hero.title: Architects and project managers for Papua New Guinea.
hero.sub: Nationally owned since 1996. Architectural design, consultation and project management for clients from home owners to mid-size commercial developments.

about: OTI Architects Ltd set foot in the industry on 8 February 1996, aiming to make an integral contribution to the development of Papua New Guinea and its growing building industry by delivering the needs of each client effectively and efficiently.

The firm is 100% nationally owned and provides professional architectural advice and services, in association with a close network of building industry professionals. Work has been undertaken throughout the country, in major provincial centres and remote district areas.
aboutShort: OTI Architects is led by founder and Managing Director Alama Oti, a registered architect. Our vision is simple: successful projects and good outcomes for the people involved.
We work in association with major clients, builders, fellow architects and engineers, in flexible project teams to suit each project.
quote: Our vision is simple: to achieve the common good of successful projects and the people involved.

timeline.t: Lae Central Complex, designed by Alama Oti.
OTI Architects is founded on 8 February.
Workers Mutual Centre completed in Port Moresby.
Lae Biscuit Factory completed in Lae.

credentials.t: Registered architectural company with the PNG Board of Architects, No. C17-007. Alama Oti is registered architect No. 044.
Members of the PNG Institute of Architects.
Professional indemnity, public liability and workers compensation, current to February 2027.
